basic_info.description: NEW PRICE! Located on the top floor of a sweet two-unit building in the heart of San Francisco's sunny and vibrant Bernal Heights, this light filled condominium offers a fantastic open floor plan, two bedrooms, a full bath and a private garage. The open living space includes a spacious chef's kitchen with stone counters and abundant cabinetry, spacious dining and living areas - perfect for gatherings. At the rear of the home, you'll find two generous bedrooms and a stunning full bath, complete with a separate soaking tub and stall shower. Treasures include in-unit laundry, one-car private garage parking, and gleaming wood floors. With a wide array of shops, restaurants and amenities just a block away on Cortland Avenue and lovely Holly Park just to the west, the location can't be beat.
